test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for the underlined word in the given sentence.

He is a __lazy__ person.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Hardworking**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"lazy"** means someone who is unwilling to work or put in effort; it refers to being inactive, sluggish, or avoiding tasks. (आलसी)

 
 
• **Example:** He is too lazy to clean his room even though it is very messy.
 
 
 
• **"Hardworking"** refers to someone who puts in a lot of effort and dedication into their tasks or work; it is the opposite of being lazy. (परिश्रमी)
 
 
• **Example:** She is a hardworking student who always completes her assignments on time.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'lazy' **is **'hardworking'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Hardworking**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Perfect **(संपूर्ण ): Something that is flawless or without any mistakes.

 
 
• **Example:** The painting was so perfect that it left everyone in awe.
 
 
 
• **Casual **(अनौपचारिक ): Something relaxed, informal, or not planned with seriousness.
 
 
• **Example:** He wore casual clothes to the party instead of formal attire.
 
 
 
• **Popular** (लोकप्रिय ): Someone or something that is liked or admired by many people.
 
 
• **Example:** The singer is very popular among teenagers.
